prompt: For how long was the "Father of the National Parks", the first president to declare a national park, and the president who declared the most national parks all alive at the same time?
answer:
The three were:

- **John Muir**, the “Father of the National Parks” (April 21, 1838–December 24, 1914)
- **Ulysses S. Grant**, who established the first national park, Yellowstone (April 27, 1822–July 23, 1885)
- **Theodore Roosevelt**, who established the most national parks (October 27, 1858–January 6, 1919)

Their shared lifetime ran from **Theodore Roosevelt’s birth on October 27, 1858, to Ulysses S. Grant’s death on July 23, 1885**—a total of **26 years, 8 months, and 26 days**.
